@luaprot/global/LP_BLACKLIST.documentation:
Blacklists the current key and/or fingerprint. Must be **called** with one string argument (for example a reason or note).

Overwriting LuaProt runtime globals will crash the game.

params.name: reason
params.documentation: Reason or note recorded with the blacklist.

@luaprot/global/LP_DISCORD.documentation:
Discord display name linked to the current key. If no Discord account is linked, this is `"unknown"`.

Read-only; assigning to LuaProt runtime globals will crash the game.

@luaprot/global/LP_DISCORD_ID.documentation:
Discord user ID linked to the current key. If no Discord account is linked, this is `0`.

Read-only; assigning to LuaProt runtime globals will crash the game.

@luaprot/global/LP_EXECUTIONS.documentation:
Total executions recorded for the current user/key. If not whitelisted, this is `0`.

Read-only; assigning to LuaProt runtime globals will crash the game.

@luaprot/global/LP_FINGERPRINT.documentation:
Hardware/fingerprint string supplied by the executor.

Read-only; assigning to LuaProt runtime globals will crash the game.

@luaprot/global/LP_KEYNOTE.documentation:
Note attached to the key on the dashboard. Empty string (`""`) when not whitelisted.

Read-only; assigning to LuaProt runtime globals will crash the game.

@luaprot/global/LP_PREMIUM.documentation:
`true` when the user is whitelisted—useful for freemium (FFA) scripts. Also `false` for keys produced by the key system.

Read-only; assigning to LuaProt runtime globals will crash the game.
@luaprot/global/LP_PREMIUM.code_sample:
if LP_PREMIUM then
    print("You're a premium user!")
else
    print("You are not premium.")
end

@luaprot/global/LP_SCRIPT_EXECUTIONS.documentation:
Total executions for **this script** across users.

Read-only; assigning to LuaProt runtime globals will crash the game.
@luaprot/global/LP_SCRIPT_EXECUTIONS.code_sample: print("The script has " .. LP_SCRIPT_EXECUTIONS .. " executions in total")

@luaprot/global/LP_SCRIPT_NAME.documentation:
Script name configured on the LuaProt dashboard.

Read-only; assigning to LuaProt runtime globals will crash the game.

@luaprot/global/LP_SCRIPT_VERSION.documentation:
Script version string (maintained/updated by LuaProt).

Read-only; assigning to LuaProt runtime globals will crash the game.

@luaprot/global/LP_SESSION_COUNT.documentation:
How many users are running **any** script under the same hub. Updates in real time.

Read-only; assigning to LuaProt runtime globals will crash the game.
@luaprot/global/LP_SESSION_COUNT.code_sample: print("There are " .. LP_SESSION_COUNT .. " people using the script")

@luaprot/global/LP_SESSION_ID.documentation:
Session identifier for use with LuaProt session APIs. May be provided as a string or number depending on the hub integration.

Read-only; assigning to LuaProt runtime globals will crash the game.

@luaprot/global/LP_TIMELEFT.documentation:
Seconds remaining until the key expires. `0` means it never expires. Updates in real time.

Read-only; assigning to LuaProt runtime globals will crash the game.
@luaprot/global/LP_TIMELEFT.code_sample: print("Your key has " .. LP_TIMELEFT .. " seconds remaining")

@luaprot/global/LP_INIT.documentation: Runs the given closure **before** LuaProt's main authentication logic. Useful for anticheat bypasses or other setup that must happen ahead of auth.

params.name: closure
params.documentation: Any function body to execute prior to authentication.

@luaprot/global/LP_VMIFY.documentation: Virtualizes the input function to strengthen obfuscation. This significantly hurts runtime performance because execution runs inside an extra VM layer.
@luaprot/global/LP_VMIFY.code_sample:
local run = LP_VMIFY(function()
    -- sensitive logic
end)
run()

@luaprot/global/LP_ENCSTR.documentation: Transforms a string constant so it is harder to recover from constant dumps or similar static analysis.

@luaprot/global/LP_DASHBOARD.documentation: Dashboard bridge for script UX: subscribe to component updates from the user's dashboard and push live values back to it.

@luaprot/global/LP_DASHBOARD.Connect.documentation: Registers a callback for a dashboard component ID. Use this for toggles such as enabling or disabling autofarm features.

params.name: componentId
params.documentation: Identifier of the dashboard widget to listen to.

params.name: callback
params.documentation: Invoked when the component changes; values may be boolean toggles, numeric sliders, or strings depending on the widget.

@luaprot/global/LP_DASHBOARD.Fire.documentation: Pushes an updated value to a dashboard component so you can reflect live stats (for example autofarm counters).

params.name: componentId
params.documentation: Identifier of the dashboard widget to update.

params.name: value
params.documentation: Primitive payload shown by the component.

@luaprot/global/LP_SAVE_VALUE.documentation: Writes a namespaced storage value tied to the user's key or HWID—ideal for cloud configs or persistent counters such as lifetime kills.

params.name: overwrite
params.documentation: When `true`, writes or replaces the stored entry; when `false`, an existing value may be preserved depending on your LuaProt integration.

@luaprot/global/LP_GET_VALUE.documentation: Loads a previously saved storage value for the current key/HWID pairing.

@luaprot/global/LP_DELETE_VALUE.documentation: Removes a stored entry when it is no longer needed.

@luaprot/global/LP_SECURE_REQUEST.documentation: Issues an end-to-end encrypted request through LuaProt's proxy to frustrate HTTP interception. This materially raises the effort required for attackers but does not provide absolute guarantees.

params.name: data
params.documentation: Structured request payload interpreted by LuaProt (fields depend on your integration).
